Compare Submission Readiness Between Two Evidence Snapshots

Source: R/compare.R
compare_readiness.Rd

Compares a baseline evidence snapshot against a current one and returns the change in headline readiness: the Submission Confidence Index (SCI) delta, the decision-band move, the per-pillar score deltas, and a row-level evidence diff summary (how many indicators were added, removed, improved, or regressed).

Usage

compare_readiness(baseline, current)

Arguments

baseline

A validated evidence data.frame taken as the earlier ("before") snapshot, such as one produced by generate_demo_evidence().

current

A validated evidence data.frame taken as the later ("after") snapshot. The diff is computed as baseline -> current, so an improvement in current shows as a positive net_delta.

Value

A named list with elements:

sci

A list with the before and after SCI values and their delta (after - before).

band

A list with the before and after decision bands and a logical changed flag.

n_critical

A list with the before and after critical-finding counts and their delta.

pillars

A data.frame with one row per pillar: pillar, score_before, score_after, delta, and weight, ordered by the size of the move (largest absolute delta first).

diff

The row-level r4subcore::evidence_diff() data.frame of changed, added, and removed indicators.

diff_summary

A named numeric vector of the r4subcore::evidence_diff_summary() metrics (for example n_improved, n_regressed, net_delta).

Details

This is the pure, non-reactive helper behind the dashboard's Compare tab. It only surfaces values the engine packages already compute (r4subscore::compute_pillar_scores(), r4subscore::compute_sci(), and r4subcore::evidence_diff() / r4subcore::evidence_diff_summary()); it does not define any new scoring or regulatory semantics. Because it is a plain data-frame-in, list-out function with no shiny dependency, it is easy to unit test on its own.

Examples

before <- suppressMessages(generate_demo_evidence(60, seed = 1))
after  <- suppressMessages(generate_demo_evidence(60, seed = 2))
cmp <- compare_readiness(before, after)
cmp$sci$delta
#> [1] -12.3
cmp$pillars
#>      pillar score_before score_after       delta weight
#> 1   quality    0.4916667   0.2800000 -0.21166667   0.35
#> 2 usability    0.5173611   0.3458333 -0.17152778   0.15
#> 3     trace    0.4562500   0.3854167 -0.07083333   0.25
#> 4      risk    0.3395833   0.3174603 -0.02212302   0.25
